description: Source code for the HT16K33 LED driver with keyscan support in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, LED control, brightness, blinking, and optional keyscan interrupt handling.

methods.name: ht16k33_led_blink
methods.description: Controls blinking of all LEDs at a specified frequency.

methods.name: ht16k33_led_set_state
methods.description: Sets individual LED on or off.

methods.name: ht16k33_process_keyscan_data
methods.description: Reads and processes key scan data from the device.

methods.name: ht16k33_timer_callback
methods.description: Timer callback for polling keyscan data.

methods.name: ht16k33_register_keyscan_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for keyscan events.

methods.name: ht16k33_init
methods.description: Initializes the HT16K33 device, sets up display and keyscan.
